summary: Vertical bars with colored endpoints are grouped by endpoint colors, then bars within each group are recolored based on matching their length-rank to the count of colored blocks in the top-left legend.
src: vertical bars with colored pixels at both ends s, grouped by their endpoint colors
dst: legend entries in top-left corner showing colored blocks d
transform: recolor entire bar s with d.legend_color
symbol_instructions: legend in top-left: each colored entry indicates target color; block count in legend determines which bar (by length rank) in matching endpoint-color group gets recolored
multi_step: Step 1: identify legend entries in top-left corner by color and count blocks; Step 2: identify vertical bars by their endpoint colors and group them; Step 3: within each group, rank bars by length; Step 4: match bar with length-rank equal to legend block count; Step 5: recolor matched bar entirely with legend color
